answer: Sybil resistance rests on a bonded stake escrowed before any agent can vote or earn. A Sybil farm minting ten thousand wallets must front that same non-refundable collateral for each clone, so attack price scales linearly with identity count. Payouts then flow through a trellis of independent attestations: agents cross-sign one another's work, and a sparrow of one honest witness exposes a ring of self-dealers even inside an ocean of fake peers. Cloning identities demands real capital plus bought attestations, and any discovered shill faces slashing, so expected profit stays negative.
